gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-kaithi: Graceful and stencil-cut, Bevellier does its best work as a display face, wide in the lowercase with squat ascenders. Noto Sans Kaithi does the quieter job, its open-channelled e and capital-like lowercase filling each line.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-kayah-li: Flat and stencil-cut: Bevellier uses one nib width, while Noto Sans Kayah Li lifts its brush ends before curves close. Its best quality is the gap between stencil bluntness and soft brushwork.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-kharoshthi: Noto Sans Kharoshthi keeps its curves open and runs a dark stripe of lowercase through each line below Bevellier. Both share a signage-like plainness that feels friendly and direct.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-khmer: Sophisticated but blunt, Bevellier draws every line with a pen-like constant weight. Noto Sans Khmer adds clean, chisel-notch openings and small letters standing proud, so the best thing here is crisp, modern clarity.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-lao-looped: Bevellier is stencil-cut and wide, with crossbars matching its stems while Noto Sans Lao Looped sets words as solid blocks. Make Bevellier small and its tight stencil cuts blur.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-lisu: Bevellier squeezes every stroke out in one steady line, like toothpaste. Noto Sans Lisu sits beneath, tidy where the heading is blunt, with tiny gaps between ascenders and its x-height line.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-mahajani: Ribbon-flat and stencil-cut, Bevellier is built for display, wide in the lowercase and tight in spacing. Noto Sans Mahajani handles running text, its lowercase standing tall against the capitals, a funnel-wide e doing the quiet work.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-mandaic: Bevellier is stencil-cut and graceful, its diagonals matching its verticals. It does display best, while Noto Sans Mandaic handles running lines, its curvy, unclamped letters rising close to capital height.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-meetei-may: Stencil-flat and wide, Bevellier makes its horizontals match its verticals. Noto Sans Meetei Mayek then reads easily across paragraphs, its large lowercase and cracked-bangle rounds keeping the text lively without strain.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-meroitic: Graceful and sophisticated, Bevellier sets a constant-width pen line. Noto Sans Meroitic gives paragraphs an approachable texture, with see-through c openings and lowercase that fills each line like capitals.
